text.tspan: Youth labor force participation rate: males vs. females 1990 to 2025
Share of the working-age population aged 15-24 who are economically active (employed or unemployed).

tspan.tspan: ILO Modelled Estimates, via World Bank (2026)
All figures correspond to modeled ILO estimates. Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods

text.tspan: for own use, such as subsistence farming.
